description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Membership Table implementation using SQL Server. It tests various functionalities such as initializing the membership table, inserting and reading rows, updating entries, and cleaning up defunct entries, specifically targeted at the SQL Server backend.

classes.name: SqlServerMembershipTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the Orleans SQL Server-based membership table, inheriting from MembershipTableTestsBase.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logger filters for the test class.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of the SQL Server membership table for testing.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates an instance of the gateway list provider.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Returns the ADO.NET invariant name specific to SQL Server.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a connection string for the test database.
